description: Temporary endpoint containment. Blocks POST requests to the documented vulnerable operation at /_layouts/15/ToolPane.aspx.
affected_versions: Microsoft Microsoft SharePoint Enterprise Server 2016: 16.0.0 to <16.0.5508.1000; Microsoft Microsoft SharePoint Server 2019: 16.0.0 to <16.0.10417.20027; Microsoft Microsoft SharePoint Server Subscription Edition: 16.0.0 to <16.0.18526.20424; Microsoft Microsoft SharePoint Enterprise Server 2016: 16.0.0 to <16.0.5513.1001; Microsoft Microsoft SharePoint Server 2019: 16.0.0 to <16.0.10417.20037; Microsoft Microsoft SharePoint Server Subscription Edition: 16.0.0 to <16.0.18526.20508; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Blocks POST requests to the documented vulnerable operation at /_layouts/15/ToolPane.aspx.
limitations: The body or authentication mechanism is not inspected; disabling this delivery endpoint is not exploit detection. Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Blocks legitimate uses of this operation too. This is a temporary containment option for policies that can disable the operation; review application compatibility before enabling.
